summary: The visual loop every other presentation card iterates in: the capture tool renders any scene at a chosen size after a chosen settle, refuses a black or uniform frame, and writes a thumbnail; tools/capture-scenes.sh and its PowerShell twin render every scene under scenes/review, scenes/world, scenes/battle and scenes/shell; a captures job in CI uploads the set; docs/verification/captures/ says how to look and carries the first set.

coordination.notes: Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at f5d26d1. No game/scripts, no scenes, no project.godot, no Rust, no content, no docs/SHIP_PLAN.md. AGENTS.md section 0: the capture tool was extended in place rather than copied -- one tool answers 'render this scene to a PNG' and every P lane calls it; the shell and PowerShell scripts are twins of each other in the shape verify-godot.sh/.ps1 already established, not two implementations. One deliberate edit outside the new job in .github/workflows/verify.yml: GODOT_VERSION, GODOT_ASSET and GODOT_SHA512 moved verbatim, with their comment, from godot-suites' job env to the workflow env, because the captures job downloads the same engine and a pin copied into two jobs is two answers to one question. godot-suites is otherwise untouched and stayed green on the same run, reading the hoisted values. Owner's Godot-courtesy instruction of 2026-09-06 arrived mid-lane and changed the design: the tool now takes a LIST of scenes and renders all of them in ONE engine process (the script runs exactly two engine invocations, one import pass and one capture run), local captures are 1280x720, and every local invocation ran nice -n 10, under timeout, with ulimit -v 4000000, one at a time. One honest limit recorded rather than papered over: scenes/world/black_beach/reception_terrace_navigation.tscn is an empty NavigationRegion3D and two Marker3Ds -- its own metadata says authored_navigation_shell_pending_baked_walk_mesh -- so there is no picture of it to take. It is reported as skipped by name in every run and in the CI log, and it is not in the committed ledger. The day it gains geometry it is captured like everything else. scenes/shell does not exist yet; the glob skips a missing directory rather than failing.
